title: Fronting in the Story of Tenochtitlan

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *Crucial fue la intervención del mediador* and *En aquella ciudad comenzó la rebelión* from B2 Unit 1: this is fronting. You also know *resultar* + adjective from B1 Unit 15. Fronting moves the piece you want to stress to the front of the sentence, and the subject then usually comes after the verb. Writers of history use it to mark the high point of a paragraph. This lesson applies it to Tenochtitlan: the city on the lake, its causeways and dike, and the siege.

sections.title: What can go first
rows: Importante fue el albarradón de Nezahualcóyotl. (Important was the dike of Nezahualcóyotl.)
Place or time phrase + verb + subject
En un islote del lago de Texcoco fundaron los mexicas su ciudad. (On an islet in Lake Texcoco the Mexica founded their city.)
De gran importancia fueron las calzadas para la vida de la ciudad. (Of great importance were the causeways for the life of the city.)

sections.title: Two rules to keep
sections.content: The verb and the adjective agree with the subject that comes after them: *Importante fue el albarradón*, *Importantes fueron las calzadas* (not *fue las calzadas*). And the subject stays behind the verb: *Importantes las calzadas fueron* sounds unnatural. The usual order is still fine and more common: fronting is for the moment you want to stress.

items.spanish: Muy importante fue el albarradón de Nezahualcóyotl para proteger la ciudad.
items.english: The dike of Nezahualcóyotl was very important for protecting the city.

items.spanish: Junto a la catedral aparecieron los restos del Templo Mayor.
items.english: Next to the cathedral the remains of the Templo Mayor appeared.

items.spanish: Por la calzada del sur entraron en la ciudad los soldados de Cortés.
items.english: By the southern causeway Cortés's soldiers entered the city.

items.spanish: Terrible fue la epidemia de viruela que mató a muchos habitantes.
items.english: Terrible was the smallpox epidemic that killed many inhabitants.

items.spanish: Sobre los restos de Tenochtitlan se construyó la ciudad colonial.
items.english: On the remains of Tenochtitlan the colonial city was built.

sections.content: Fronting works as a climax: use it once in a paragraph, at the point you want to stress. If every sentence starts with its adjective, the text sounds heavy.
